strengths: Touch targets are consistently 44px across every interactive control — footer buttons, chronicle links, tab bar, delete confirm — so one-handed play never misfires
The pace pulse-dot (flowpulse animation, 2.6s breathing, freezes when paused, speeds amber in hurry mode) gives at-a-glance liveness without eating screen space
Fast-forward via tap-the-flow-text is genuinely satisfying in short bursts: the years race, a moment interrupts, it auto-pauses — no extra menu needed
safe-area-inset-bottom in the footer means the game sits correctly on notched phones without clipping
The reflect button ('how things stand') has a visible border (1px solid at 45% opacity) and the ⊙ prefix makes it feel like a live control, not a label
Cold-start confirmation line ('Continuing House X — 3rd of the line, age 47') appears in the fading log so a returning player knows exactly where they re-entered without any modal
Choice hint text is always-visible on touch devices via @media (hover:none) — no hover required to read the subtext
The load-menu dismiss button is sticky-bottom with a dark gradient fade, so it stays reachable on short phones with multiple saved slots
The 13px monospace save-code textarea uses user-select:all/-webkit-user-select:all so one tap selects the whole code — essential for cross-device play
Content quality holds up perfectly for short-burst play: each moment is self-contained, the prose is immediate, and choices resolve in a single tap with no reading overhead

improvements.what: Give the reflect button a slightly larger touch target — it currently has no min-height set (unlike the 44px footer buttons), so it sits at roughly 30px tall at 13.5px font with 5px padding
improvements.why: A player tapping quickly between the being line and the stage area may miss it; adding min-height:44px (matching every other interactive control in the game) would eliminate the only remaining tap-target gap

improvements.what: Add a one-time onboarding hint pointing to the pace-text control (the flow div), similar to the existing constellation and log hints
improvements.why: The pulse-dot signals liveness but does not communicate that the text is tappable; new players in short sessions may never discover fast-forward and spend whole sessions unable to skip the quiet years

verdict: A genuinely excellent mobile experience — every touch target, every one-handed affordance, and every short-session re-entry detail is handled correctly; the two remaining notes from last round (reflect min-height, pace discoverability) are still present but neither breaks the core loop, so the score nudges up slightly.
